items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I mean, Bix, not Bix, Bias Dauphin. Yeah. Bias Dauphin used to play out there.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was Ridgely and Solestamp's tuxedo band.
And I'll tell you, they played out there too. They had a dance floor out there too. I mean, Bix, not Bix, Bias Dauphin. Yeah. Bias Dauphin used to play out there.
Did you ever go to the Tokyo Gardens, do I think?
